# Overview

This script analyzes CGM data during the in-laboratory period experimental evening periods:

-   Group 1 (P01, P02, P03): 11 days from 2025-06-16, 18:30-23:30 (HBT = 00:00)
-   Group 2 (P04, P05): 10 days from 2025-06-30, 16:30-21:30 (HBT = 22:00)
-   Group 3 (P06, P07, P09): 10 days from 2025-07-28, 18:00-23:00 (HBT = 23:30)
-   Group 4 (P10): 13 days from 2025-08-11, 17:30-22:30 (HBT = 23:00)

Note: Session 5 for P10 is excluded due to light automation malfunction.

# Standardize Column Names

Different participants have different device languages (English, Dutch, German).

```{r standardize-columns, eval=!SKIP_PROCESSING}
# Function to standardize glucose dataframe
standardize_glucose_df <- function(df, lang = "en") {
  
  # Determine column names based on language
  if (lang == "en") {
    cols <- c("Device", "Serial Number", "Device Timestamp", 
              "Record Type", "Historic Glucose mg/dL")
  } else if (lang == "nl") {
    cols <- c("Apparaat", "Serienummer", "Tijdstempel apparaat", 
              "Gegevenstype", "Historische glucose mg/dl")
  } else if (lang == "de") {
    cols <- c("Gerät", "Seriennummer", "Gerätezeitstempel", 
              "Aufzeichnungstyp", "Glukosewert-Verlauf mg/dL")
  }
  
  # Handle potential encoding issues in German column names
  if (lang == "de") {
    col_check <- names(df)[grepl("Ger.*t", names(df))]
    if (length(col_check) > 0) {
      cols[1] <- col_check[1]
      cols[3] <- col_check[2]
    }
  }
  
  df %>%
    select(all_of(cols)) %>%
    rename(device = 1,
           serial_number = 2,
           timestamp = 3,
           record_type = 4,
           glucose = 5) %>%
    # Keep only Record Type 0 (historic glucose, not manual scans)
    filter(record_type == 0) %>%
    select(-record_type) %>%
    mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

# Standardize each participant
glucose_P01 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P01, "en")
glucose_P02 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P02, "nl")
glucose_P03 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P03, "en")
glucose_P04 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P04, "de")
glucose_P05 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P05, "en")
glucose_P06 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P06, "en")
glucose_P07 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P07, "en")
glucose_P09 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P09, "en")
glucose_P10 <- standardize_glucose_df(glucose_P10, "en")
```

# Filter to Experimental Evenings Only

```{r filter-experimental-evenings, eval=!SKIP_PROCESSING}
# Function to filter experimental evenings by group
filter_experimental_evenings <- function(df, participant_id, group) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      participant = participant_id,
      date = as.Date(datetime),
      hour = hour(datetime),
      minute = minute(datetime)
    )
  
  if (group == 1) {
    # Group 1: P01, P02, P03 - 11 days from 2025-06-16, 18:30-23:30
    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        date >= as.Date("2025-06-16") & date <= as.Date("2025-06-26") &
        ((hour == 18 & minute >= 30) | (hour >= 19 & hour < 23) | (hour == 23 & minute <= 30))
      )
  } else if (group == 2) {
    # Group 2: P04, P05 - 10 days from 2025-06-30, 16:30-21:30
    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        date >= as.Date("2025-06-30") & date <= as.Date("2025-07-09") &
        ((hour == 16 & minute >= 30) | (hour >= 17 & hour < 21) | (hour == 21 & minute <= 30))
      )
  } else if (group == 3) {
    # Group 3: P06, P07, P09 - 10 days from 2025-07-28, 18:00-23:00
    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        date >= as.Date("2025-07-28") & date <= as.Date("2025-08-06") &
        hour >= 18 & hour <= 23
      )
  } else if (group == 4) {
    # Group 4: P10 - 13 days from 2025-08-11, 17:30-22:30
    # Exclude session 5 (2025-08-15)
    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        date >= as.Date("2025-08-11") & date <= as.Date("2025-08-23") &
        date != as.Date("2025-08-15") &  # Exclude session 5
        ((hour == 17 & minute >= 30) | (hour >= 18 & hour < 22) | (hour == 22 & minute <= 30))
      )
  }
  
  df %>%
    select(participant, device, serial_number, datetime, glucose) %>%
    mutate(timestamp = format(datetime, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")) %>%
    select(participant, device, serial_number, timestamp, glucose)
}

# Apply filtering to all participants
glucose_P01 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P01, "P01", group = 1)
glucose_P02 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P02, "P02", group = 1)
glucose_P03 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P03, "P03", group = 1)
glucose_P04 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P04, "P04", group = 2)
glucose_P05 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P05, "P05", group = 2)
glucose_P06 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P06, "P06", group = 3)
glucose_P07 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P07, "P07", group = 3)
glucose_P09 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P09, "P09", group = 3)
glucose_P10 <- filter_experimental_evenings(glucose_P10, "P10", group = 4)
```

# Data Summary

```{r data-summary, eval=!SKIP_PROCESSING}
# Summary by participant
summary_table <- cgm_experimental %>%
  mutate(glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose)) %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    first_timestamp = min(timestamp),
    last_timestamp = max(timestamp),
    mean_glucose = round(mean(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_glucose = round(sd(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    min_glucose = round(min(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    max_glucose = round(max(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)

# Summary by group
cgm_experimental %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ "Group 1",
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ "Group 2",
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ "Group 3",
      participant == "P10" ~ "Group 4"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()
```

# Check Data Quality

```{r check-data-quality}
# Calculate quality metrics per evening (before aggregating to 30-min blocks)
cgm_quality <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    # Determine group
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      participant == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    # Session number
    session_num = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-16"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-30"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-07-28"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-08-11"), units = "days")) + 1
    )
  ) %>%
  # Calculate rate of change between consecutive measurements
  arrange(participant, datetime) %>%
  group_by(participant, date) %>%
  mutate(
    glucose_lag = lag(glucose_numeric),
    time_diff = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins")),
    change_abs = abs(glucose_numeric - glucose_lag),
    rate_of_change = change_abs / time_diff
  ) %>%
  # Summary per evening
  summarise(
    session = first(session_num),
    n_measurements = n(),
    min_glucose = min(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_glucose = max(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_glucose = max_glucose - min_glucose,
    mean_glucose = round(mean(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd_glucose = round(sd(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    max_absolute_change = round(max(change_abs, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    max_rate_of_change = round(max(rate_of_change, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant, session)

# Display as interactive table
datatable(
  cgm_quality,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe',
  caption = "CGM Quality Metrics per Evening"
) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'max_absolute_change',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(20, c('white', 'red'))
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'max_glucose',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(200, c('white', 'yellow'))
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'min_glucose',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(60, c('yellow', 'white'))
  )

# Calculate percentage of low glucose values (< 60 mg/dL)
cgm_low_glucose_analysis <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    is_low = glucose_numeric < 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_measurements = n(),
    n_low = sum(is_low, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_low = round((n_low / total_measurements) * 100, 2),
    min_glucose = min(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_below_50 = sum(glucose_numeric < 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_below_50 = round((n_below_50 / total_measurements) * 100, 2),
    n_below_40 = sum(glucose_numeric < 40, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_below_40 = round((n_below_40 / total_measurements) * 100, 2)
  )

# Display results
print(cgm_low_glucose_analysis)
```

Interpretation data quality: despite some quite small minimum glucose values for the following participants during specific sessions, data quality seems to be appropriate, despite P09 on day 31.07.2025, which will be investigated in the next step:

-   P01, Session 3: minimum = 58 mg/dL

-   P02, Session 7: minimum = 43 mg/dL

-   P03, Session 9 & 10: minimum = 60 & 57 mg/dL

-   P09, Session 2: minimum = 58 mg/dL

-   P09, Session 4: minimum = 56 mg/dL

-   P10, Session 2: minimum = 55 mg/dL

-   P10, Session 6; minimum = 60 mg/dL

# Inspect P09 day 31/07/2025

```{r check-p09}
# Inspect individual measurements for P09 on 2025-07-31
p09_july31 <- cgm %>%
  filter(participant == "P09") %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose)
  ) %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-07-31")) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  mutate(
    glucose_lag = lag(glucose_numeric),
    time_diff = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins")),
    change = glucose_numeric - glucose_lag,
    change_abs = abs(change),
    rate_of_change = change_abs / time_diff
  ) %>%
  select(datetime, glucose_numeric, glucose_lag, time_diff, change, change_abs, rate_of_change)

# Display as interactive table
datatable(
  p09_july31,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe',
  caption = "P09 Individual Measurements - 2025-07-31"
) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'change_abs',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(10, 20), c('white', 'yellow', 'red'))
  ) %>%
  formatRound(columns = c('rate_of_change'), digits = 2)
```

Interpretation: The drastic change in continuous measurements for P09, Session 31/07/2025 is due to a Disconnect Event with missing data between 18:20 and 21:14. Therefore the large jump in glucose values is justified and retained.

# Check for missing data during 5h chamber exposure

```{r check-missing-data}
# Check for missing 5-minute intervals
cgm_missing <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    # Determine group
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      participant == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    # Session number
    session_num = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-16"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-30"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-07-28"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-08-11"), units = "days")) + 1
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant, datetime) %>%
  group_by(participant, date) %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins"))
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    session = first(session_num),
    n_measurements = n(),
    expected_measurements = 61,  # 5 hours * 12 measurements per hour + 1
    missing_measurements = expected_measurements - n_measurements,
    min_interval = min(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_interval = max(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_interval = round(mean(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_gaps_over_5min = sum(time_diff > 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gap_minutes = max(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant, session)

# Display as interactive table
datatable(
  cgm_missing,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe',
  caption = "CGM Missing Data Check per Evening"
) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'missing_measurements',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0, 5), c('lightgreen', 'yellow', 'red'))
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'max_gap_minutes',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(5, 10), c('white', 'yellow', 'red'))
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(
    'n_gaps_over_5min',
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0, 3), c('lightgreen', 'yellow', 'red'))
  )
```

Interpretation: Except for P04 Session 9 (1 gap of 10 min) and P09 Session 4 (no data between 18:20 and 21:14), the measurement interval sometimes shifted to 6 minutes instead of 5 minutes. All in all reasonable data quality can be assumed. Note: Although the FreeStyle Libre is designed to record glucose every 5 minutes, slight sensor or transmitter timing variability can occasionally cause intervals of 6 minutes between readings.

# Check for missing data during intervention window only (1.5h)

```{r check-missing-data-intervention-window}
# Check for missing 5-minute intervals during intervention window only 
cgm_missing_intervention <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    hour = hour(datetime),
    minute = minute(datetime),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    # Determine group
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      participant == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    # Session number
    session_num = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-16"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-30"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-07-28"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-08-11"), units = "days")) + 1
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter to intervention windows only
  filter(
    # Group 1: 21:30-23:00
    (group == 1 & ((hour == 21 & minute >= 30) | (hour == 22) | (hour == 23 & minute == 0))) |
    # Group 2: 19:30-21:00
    (group == 2 & ((hour == 19 & minute >= 30) | (hour == 20) | (hour == 21 & minute == 0))) |
    # Group 3: 21:00-22:30
    (group == 3 & ((hour == 21) | (hour == 22 & minute <= 30))) |
    # Group 4: 20:30-22:00
    (group == 4 & ((hour == 20 & minute >= 30) | (hour == 21) | (hour == 22 & minute == 0)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant, datetime) %>%
  group_by(participant, date) %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins"))
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    session = first(session_num),
    n_measurements = n(),
    expected_measurements = 19,  # 1.5 hours * 12 measurements per hour + 1
    missing_measurements = expected_measurements - n_measurements,
    min_interval = min(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_interval = max(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_interval = round(mean(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_gaps_over_5min = sum(time_diff > 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gap_minutes = max(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(participant, session)
```

# Create 30-minute blocks and calculate mean glucose per block

```{r create-30-minute-blocks}
# Create 30-minute blocks and calculate mean glucose per block
cgm_blocks <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    # Assign group based on participant
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      participant == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    # Calculate time relative to start of experimental evening for each group
    time_relative = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(datetime, as.POSIXct(paste(date, "18:30:00"), tz = "UTC"), units = "mins")),
      group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(datetime, as.POSIXct(paste(date, "16:30:00"), tz = "UTC"), units = "mins")),
      group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(datetime, as.POSIXct(paste(date, "18:00:00"), tz = "UTC"), units = "mins")),
      group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(datetime, as.POSIXct(paste(date, "17:30:00"), tz = "UTC"), units = "mins"))
    ),
    # Create 30-minute blocks (0-30, 30-60, 60-90, etc.)
    block_30min = floor(time_relative / 30) + 1
  ) %>%
  # Keep only valid blocks (1-10)
  filter(block_30min >= 1 & block_30min <= 10) %>%
  # Calculate mean glucose per participant, date, and block
  group_by(participant, date, block_30min) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_glucose = mean(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_glucose = sd(glucose_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View the result
print(cgm_blocks, n = Inf)
```

```{r individual-cgm-time-courses}
# Function to create plot for one participant
create_glucose_plot <- function(participant_id, info) {
  
  cgm_plot <- cgm_blocks %>%
    filter(participant == participant_id) %>%
    mutate(
      session_num = case_when(
        info$group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-16"), units = "days")) + 1,
        info$group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-30"), units = "days")) + 1,
        info$group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-07-28"), units = "days")) + 1,
        info$group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-08-11"), units = "days")) + 1
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!(participant == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
    mutate(
      light_condition = sapply(session_num, function(s) {
        if (s <= length(info$light_pattern) && !is.na(info$light_pattern[s])) {
          info$light_pattern[s]
        } else NA_character_
      }),
      hours_before_hbt = 5.5 - (block_30min * 0.5 - 0.25)
    ) %>%
    filter(hours_before_hbt >= 0.5 & hours_before_hbt <= 5.5) %>%
    arrange(session_num, hours_before_hbt)
  
  cgm_plot <- cgm_plot %>%
    left_join(food_info, by = c("participant" = "participant_id", "session_num" = "session_num"))
  
  if(nrow(cgm_plot) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data available for", participant_id))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Y-axis limits
  y_min <- floor(min(cgm_plot$mean_glucose, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 - 5
  y_max <- ceiling(max(cgm_plot$mean_glucose, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 + 5
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  # Fixed bottom-left position for all food labels
  label_positions <- cgm_plot %>%
    group_by(session_num) %>%
    summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      label_x = 5.2,
      label_y = y_min + y_range * 0.03,
      label_hjust = 0,
      label_vjust = 0
    )
  
  # X-axis labels with HBT times (odd blocks only)
  x_labels <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)",
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(cgm_plot, aes(x = hours_before_hbt, y = mean_glucose)) +
    
    # Only yellow background for B evenings, no background for D evenings
    geom_rect(data = subset(cgm_plot, light_condition == "B") %>%
                group_by(session_num) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup(),
              aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    
    # Food label: always bottom-left
    geom_text(
      data = cgm_plot %>%
        group_by(session_num) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        filter(!is.na(food_label)) %>%
        left_join(label_positions %>%
                    select(session_num, label_x, label_y, label_hjust, label_vjust),
                  by = "session_num"),
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = food_label,
          hjust = label_hjust, vjust = label_vjust),
      size = 2.8,
      color = "gray20",
      fontface = "italic",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = c(5.25, 4.75, 4.25, 3.75, 3.25, 2.75, 2.25, 1.75, 1.25, 0.75),
      labels = x_labels,
      limits = c(5.5, 0.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_min, y_max),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ session_num, ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(session_num = function(x) {
                 sapply(x, function(session) {
                   session_num <- as.numeric(session)
                   light_label <- if(session_num <= length(info$light_pattern) &&
                                    !is.na(info$light_pattern[session_num])) {
                     info$light_pattern[session_num]
                   } else "?"
                   paste0("Evening ", session_num, " (", light_label, ")")
                 })
               })) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Glucose per evening (", participant_id, ")"),
      subtitle = "Meal type (Solid/Liquid) and % consumed",
      x = "Block number (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Glucose [mg/dL]"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, color = "grey40", margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0, margin = margin(l = 2)),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 10, 10),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for all participants
for (pid in names(participant_info)) {
  plot <- create_glucose_plot(pid, participant_info[[pid]])
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    print(plot)
  }
}
```

# Mean CGM and CV (Coefficient of variation): 5h chamber exposure, 1.5h intervention window

```{r mean-values-and-CV}
# Calculate cgm_entire (entire 5h exposure window) and cgm_intervention (intervention window only)
cgm <- cgm %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    time = format(datetime, "%H:%M"),
    glucose_numeric = as.numeric(glucose),
    # Determine group
    group = case_when(
      participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      participant %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      participant == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    # Define exposure windows based on group
    in_entire_window = case_when(
      # Group 1: 18:30-23:30 (5h)
      group == 1 & time >= "18:30" & time <= "23:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 2: 16:30-21:30 (5h)
      group == 2 & time >= "16:30" & time <= "21:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 3: 18:00-23:00 (5h)
      group == 3 & time >= "18:00" & time <= "23:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 4: 17:30-22:30 (5h)
      group == 4 & time >= "17:30" & time <= "22:30" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    # Define intervention windows based on group (1.5h bright light period)
    in_intervention_window = case_when(
      # Group 1: 21:30-23:00 (1.5h)
      group == 1 & time >= "21:30" & time <= "23:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 2: 19:30-21:00 (1.5h)
      group == 2 & time >= "19:30" & time <= "21:00" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 3: 21:00-22:30 (1.5h)
      group == 3 & time >= "21:00" & time <= "22:30" ~ TRUE,
      # Group 4: 20:30-22:00 (1.5h)
      group == 4 & time >= "20:30" & time <= "22:00" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  # Calculate session number
  mutate(
    session_num = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-16"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 2 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-06-30"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 3 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-07-28"), units = "days")) + 1,
      group == 4 ~ as.numeric(difftime(date, as.Date("2025-08-11"), units = "days")) + 1
    )
  ) %>%
  # Calculate means and CV per session
  group_by(participant, session_num) %>%
  mutate(
    # Entire 5h window metrics
    cgm_entire_mean = mean(glucose_numeric[in_entire_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    cgm_entire_sd = sd(glucose_numeric[in_entire_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    cgm_entire_cv = (cgm_entire_sd / cgm_entire_mean) * 100,
    
    # Intervention 1.5h window metrics
    cgm_intervention_mean = mean(glucose_numeric[in_intervention_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    cgm_intervention_sd = sd(glucose_numeric[in_intervention_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    cgm_intervention_cv = (cgm_intervention_sd / cgm_intervention_mean) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove helper variables
  select(-in_entire_window, -in_intervention_window, -datetime, -time)
```

```{r doublet-light-patterns-doublet-definitions}
# Define light patterns for groups

# Create doublet dataframes
df_doublets_g1 <- data.frame(
```

# Calculate Doublet Data (5h window)

```{r doublet-data-calculation}
# Prepare CGM data with one row per session
cgm_session_summary <- cgm %>%
  filter(!is.na(session_num)) %>%
  group_by(participant, session_num) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(participant, session_num, cgm_entire_mean, cgm_entire_cv)

participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

# Initialize dataframes
df_plot_cgm_mean <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df_plot_cgm_cv <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cv = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through participants
for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CGM data
  cgm_data <- cgm_session_summary %>%
    filter(participant == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_num)
  
  # Join with doublets
  cgm_doublets <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cgm_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_cgm_doublets <- cgm_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cgm = mean(cgm_entire_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Calculate CV per doublet
  mean_cv_doublets <- cgm_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cv = mean(cgm_entire_cv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data for mean
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cgm_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_cgm_mean <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_mean, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cgm = mean_cgm_doublets$mean_cgm[mean_cgm_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Add to plot data for CV
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cv_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_cgm_cv <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_cv, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cv = mean_cv_doublets$mean_cv[mean_cv_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Factor doublets
df_plot_cgm_mean$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_mean$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
df_plot_cgm_cv$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_cv$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

```{r doublet-cgm-mean}
ggplot(df_plot_cgm_mean_noP07, aes(x = doublet, y = mean_cgm)) +
```

# Doublet Data (1.5h intervention window)

```{r doublet-cgm-data-intervention-window}
# Calculate doublet CGM for all participants - intervention 1.5h window
# Reuse: df_doublets_g1, df_doublets_g2, df_doublets_g4, participants, doublets

# Prepare CGM intervention data with one row per session
cgm_intervention_summary <- cgm %>%
  filter(!is.na(session_num)) %>%
  group_by(participant, session_num) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(participant, session_num, cgm_intervention_mean, cgm_intervention_cv)

# Initialize dataframes
df_plot_cgm_mean_int <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

df_plot_cgm_cv_int <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cv = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through participants
for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CGM intervention data
  cgm_data <- cgm_intervention_summary %>%
    filter(participant == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_num)
  
  # Join with doublets
  cgm_doublets <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cgm_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_cgm_doublets <- cgm_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cgm = mean(cgm_intervention_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Calculate CV per doublet
  mean_cv_doublets <- cgm_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cv = mean(cgm_intervention_cv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data for mean
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cgm_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_cgm_mean_int <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_mean_int, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cgm = mean_cgm_doublets$mean_cgm[mean_cgm_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Add to plot data for CV
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_cv_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_cgm_cv_int <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_cv_int, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_cv = mean_cv_doublets$mean_cv[mean_cv_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Factor doublets
df_plot_cgm_mean_int$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_mean_int$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
df_plot_cgm_cv_int$doublet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_cv_int$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

# Functions to calculate doublet positions for CGM metrics

```{r}
# Define participants and doublets
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

# Define colors
light_colors <- c("dim" = "#4A90E2", "bright" = "#F5A623")

# Create doublet position mappings
doublet_positions_g1 <- df_doublets_g1 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g2 <- df_doublets_g2 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g4 <- df_doublets_g4 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define participants and doublets (in case not already defined)
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

# Calculate position data for CGM mean - 5h window 
mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  sd_cgm = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Function for CGM mean (entire window)
calc_doublet_positions_cgm_mean <- function(participant_id, cgm_data, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cgm = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_mean[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cgm = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_mean[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cgm, pos2_cgm)
  return(results)
}

# Function for CGM CV (entire window)
calc_doublet_positions_cgm_cv <- function(participant_id, cgm_data, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cv = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_cv[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cv = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_cv[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cv, pos2_cv)
  return(results)
}

# Function for CGM mean (intervention window)
calc_doublet_positions_cgm_mean_int <- function(participant_id, cgm_data_int, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cgm_int = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_mean[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cgm_int = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_mean[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cgm_int, pos2_cgm_int)
  return(results)
}

# Function for CGM CV (intervention window)
calc_doublet_positions_cgm_cv_int <- function(participant_id, cgm_data_int, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cv_int = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_cv[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cv_int = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_cv[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_cv_int, pos2_cv_int)
  return(results)
}
```

# Calculate position data for CGM mean - 5h window

```{r}
mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  sd_cgm = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(d in doublets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g2
      } else {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get CGM data
      cgm_data <- cgm_session_summary %>%
        filter(participant == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
        rename(exp_session = session_num)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_cgm <- calc_doublet_positions_cgm_mean(p, cgm_data, doublet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(d %in% pos_cgm$doublet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_cgm$pos1_cgm[pos_cgm$doublet == d])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_cgm$pos2_cgm[pos_cgm$doublet == d])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 <- rbind(mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        position = pos,
        mean_cgm = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cgm = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_participants = length(values)
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_cgm_mean_noP07 <- mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = ifelse(position == "pos1", "Position 1", "Position 2"),
    position_num = ifelse(position == "pos1", 1, 2),
    light_type = ifelse(position == "pos1", 
                        substr(doublet, 1, 1),
                        substr(doublet, 2, 2)),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(doublet = factor(doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB")))
```

# Plot CGM mean positions - 5h window

```{r}

    color = "Light condition"

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cgm - sd_cgm, ymax = mean_cgm + sd_cgm),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 16) +

    title = "SD per Doublet",
    y = NULL,
    x = "Doublet"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 2,

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# Combine both plots
```

# Calculate position data for CGM mean - intervention 1.5h window

```{r}
mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  sd_cgm = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(d in doublets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g2
      } else {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get CGM intervention data
      cgm_data_int <- cgm_intervention_summary %>%
        filter(participant == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
        rename(exp_session = session_num)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_cgm_int <- calc_doublet_positions_cgm_mean_int(p, cgm_data_int, doublet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(d %in% pos_cgm_int$doublet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_cgm_int$pos1_cgm_int[pos_cgm_int$doublet == d])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_cgm_int$pos2_cgm_int[pos_cgm_int$doublet == d])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07 <- rbind(mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        position = pos,
        mean_cgm = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cgm = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_participants = length(values)
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_cgm_mean_int_noP07 <- mean_doublet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = ifelse(position == "pos1", "Position 1", "Position 2"),
    position_num = ifelse(position == "pos1", 1, 2),
    light_type = ifelse(position == "pos1", 
                        substr(doublet, 1, 1),
                        substr(doublet, 2, 2)),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(doublet = factor(doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB")))
```

# Triplet Light Pattern Analysis

## Light pattern definition

```{r}
# Define light patterns for triplets 
if(!exists("light_g1")) {
  light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
  light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
  light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))
}

# Create triplet dataframes
df_triplets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g1),
  triplet = paste0(light_g1[1:(length(light_g1) - 2)], 
                   light_g1[2:(length(light_g1) - 1)], 
                   light_g1[3:length(light_g1)])
)

df_triplets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g2) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g2) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g2),
  triplet = paste0(light_g2[1:(length(light_g2) - 2)], 
                   light_g2[2:(length(light_g2) - 1)], 
                   light_g2[3:length(light_g2)])
)

df_triplets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
  triplet = paste0(light_g4_orig[1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2)], 
                   light_g4_orig[2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1)], 
                   light_g4_orig[3:length(light_g4_orig)])
)

# Filter out triplets containing X (excluded session 5 for P10)
df_triplets_g4 <- df_triplets_g4_orig %>% 
  filter(!grepl("X", triplet))

# Create triplet position mappings
triplet_positions_g1 <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g2 <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g4 <- df_triplets_g4 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define triplets vector

  "DDD" = expression("DD"*bold("D")),
```

# Triplet light patterns, 5h window

Functions to calculate triplet positions for CGM metrics

```{r}
# Function for CGM mean (entire window)
calc_triplet_positions_cgm_mean <- function(participant_id, cgm_data, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cgm = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_mean[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cgm = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_mean[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cgm = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_mean[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cgm, pos2_cgm, pos3_cgm)
  return(results)
}

# Function for CGM CV (entire window)
calc_triplet_positions_cgm_cv <- function(participant_id, cgm_data, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cv = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_cv[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cv = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_cv[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cv = mean(cgm_data$cgm_entire_cv[cgm_data$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cv, pos2_cv, pos3_cv)
  return(results)
}
```

Calculate triplet CGM for all participants - entire 5h window

```{r}
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
triplets <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

# Initialize dataframes for mean
df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Initialize dataframes for CV
df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cv = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CGM data
  cgm_data <- cgm_session_summary %>%
    filter(participant == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_num)
  
  # Join with triplets
  cgm_triplets <- df_triplets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cgm_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per triplet
  mean_cgm_triplets <- cgm_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cgm = mean(cgm_entire_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Calculate CV per triplet
  mean_cv_triplets <- cgm_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cv = mean(cgm_entire_cv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data for mean
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cgm_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cgm = mean_cgm_triplets$mean_cgm[mean_cgm_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Add to plot data for CV
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cv_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cv = mean_cv_triplets$mean_cv[mean_cv_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Factor triplets
df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean$triplet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean$triplet, 
                                           levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                                     "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))

df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv$triplet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv$triplet, 
                                         levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                                   "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))
```

# Light pattern definition

```{r}
# Calculate triplet CGM for all participants - intervention 1.5h window

# Initialize dataframes for mean
df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean_int <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Initialize dataframes for CV
df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv_int <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_cv = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g4
  }
  
  # Get CGM intervention data
  cgm_data_int <- cgm_intervention_summary %>%
    filter(participant == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_num)
  
  # Join with triplets
  cgm_triplets <- df_triplets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(cgm_data_int, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per triplet
  mean_cgm_triplets <- cgm_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cgm = mean(cgm_intervention_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Calculate CV per triplet
  mean_cv_triplets <- cgm_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_cv = mean(cgm_intervention_cv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data for mean
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cgm_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean_int <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean_int, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cgm = mean_cgm_triplets$mean_cgm[mean_cgm_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Add to plot data for CV
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_cv_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv_int <- rbind(df_plot_cgm_triplet_cv_int, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_cv = mean_cv_triplets$mean_cv[mean_cv_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Factor triplets
df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean_int$triplet <- factor(df_plot_cgm_triplet_mean_int$triplet, 
                                               levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD",

                                             levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                                       "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))
```

# Triplet Line Plots, 5h entire window

Specify light patterns

```{r}
# Initialize dataframe for mean
mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cgm = numeric(),
  sd_cgm = numeric(),
  se_cgm = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Initialize dataframe for CV
mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_cv = numeric(),
  sd_cv = numeric(),
  se_cv = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(t in triplets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2", "pos3")) {
    values_mean <- c()
    values_cv <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
      } else {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get CGM data
      cgm_data <- cgm_session_summary %>%
        filter(participant == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session_num == 5)) %>%
        rename(exp_session = session_num)
      
      # Calculate positions for mean
      pos_cgm_mean <- calc_triplet_positions_cgm_mean(p, cgm_data, triplet_map)
      
      # Calculate positions for CV
      pos_cgm_cv <- calc_triplet_positions_cgm_cv(p, cgm_data, triplet_map)
      
      # Extract mean value
      if(t %in% pos_cgm_mean$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values_mean <- c(values_mean, pos_cgm_mean$pos1_cgm[pos_cgm_mean$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values_mean <- c(values_mean, pos_cgm_mean$pos2_cgm[pos_cgm_mean$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values_mean <- c(values_mean, pos_cgm_mean$pos3_cgm[pos_cgm_mean$triplet == t])
        }
      }
      
      # Extract CV value
      if(t %in% pos_cgm_cv$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv$pos1_cv[pos_cgm_cv$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv$pos2_cv[pos_cgm_cv$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv$pos3_cv[pos_cgm_cv$triplet == t])
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add mean data
    if(length(values_mean) > 0) {
      n <- length(values_mean)
      mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_cgm = mean(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cgm = sd(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_cgm = sd(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
    
    # Add CV data
    if(length(values_cv) > 0) {
      n <- length(values_cv)
      mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_cv = mean(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cv = sd(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_cv = sd(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting - mean
df_plot_positions_triplet_cgm_mean_noP07 <- mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ "Position 1",
      position == "pos2" ~ "Position 2",
      position == "pos3" ~ "Position 3"
    ),
    position_num = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ 1,
      position == "pos2" ~ 2,
      position == "pos3" ~ 3
    ),
    light_type = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ substr(triplet, 1, 1),
      position == "pos2" ~ substr(triplet, 2, 2),
      position == "pos3" ~ substr(triplet, 3, 3)
    ),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                              "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")))

# Prepare for plotting - CV
df_plot_positions_triplet_cgm_cv_noP07 <- mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ "Position 1",
      position == "pos2" ~ "Position 2",
      position == "pos3" ~ "Position 3"
    ),
    position_num = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ 1,
      position == "pos2" ~ 2,
      position == "pos3" ~ 3
    ),
    light_type = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ substr(triplet, 1, 1),
      position == "pos2" ~ substr(triplet, 2, 2),
      position == "pos3" ~ substr(triplet, 3, 3)
    ),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                              "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")))
```

# Triplet Line Plot, CV, 5h entire window

```{r}
calc_triplet_positions_cgm_mean_int <- function(participant_id, cgm_data_int, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cgm = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_mean[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cgm = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_mean[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cgm = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_mean[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cgm, pos2_cgm, pos3_cgm)
  return(results)
}

calc_triplet_positions_cgm_cv_int <- function(participant_id, cgm_data_int, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_cv = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_cv[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_cv = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_cv[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_cv = mean(cgm_data_int$cgm_intervention_cv[cgm_data_int$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_cv, pos2_cv, pos3_cv)
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
        }
      }
      
      # Extract CV value
      if(t %in% pos_cgm_cv_int$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv_int$pos1_cv[pos_cgm_cv_int$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv_int$pos2_cv[pos_cgm_cv_int$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values_cv <- c(values_cv, pos_cgm_cv_int$pos3_cv[pos_cgm_cv_int$triplet == t])
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add mean data
    if(length(values_mean) > 0) {
      n <- length(values_mean)
      mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_cgm_mean_int_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_cgm = mean(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cgm = sd(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_cgm = sd(values_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
    
    # Add CV data
    if(length(values_cv) > 0) {
      n <- length(values_cv)
      mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_int_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_cgm_cv_int_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_cv = mean(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cv = sd(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_cv = sd(values_cv, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting - mean
```

# Triplet Time-Course-Analysis

```{r}
# Define participants and triplets
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

# Function to get session 3 for each triplet type
get_triplet_session3 <- function(p, triplet_type) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- data.frame(
      session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) 
        paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_start != 5 & session_mid != 5 & session_end != 5)
  }
  
  sessions_3 <- df_triplets %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
    pull(session_end)
  
  return(sessions_3)
}

# Function to get all participant-session combinations for a triplet
get_triplet_sessions_overview <- function(triplet_type) {
  overview <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        overview <- rbind(overview, data.frame(
          participant_id = p,
          session = s
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(overview %>% arrange(session, participant_id))
}

# Function to get group ID from participant ID
get_group_id <- function(p) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) return(1)
  if(p %in% c("P04", "P05")) return(2)
  if(p %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09")) return(3)
  if(p == "P10") return(4)
  return(NA)
}

# Function to create CGM plot for one triplet type
plot_triplet_timecourse_cgm <- function(triplet_type) {
  df_triplet_cgm <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        p_data <- cgm %>%
          filter(participant == p, session_num == s) %>%
          filter(!is.na(timestamp), !is.na(glucose)) %>%
          mutate(timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%  
          arrange(timestamp) %>%
          mutate(
            minutes_elapsed = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, min(timestamp), units = "mins")),
            time_block = floor(minutes_elapsed / 30) + 1
          ) %>%
          group_by(time_block) %>%
          summarise(
            cgm_30min = mean(glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
            participant = first(p),
            session_num = first(s),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          filter(time_block >= 1, time_block <= 10)
        
        df_triplet_cgm <- rbind(df_triplet_cgm, p_data)
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(df_triplet_cgm) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for triplet", triplet_type))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_triplet_cgm <- df_triplet_cgm %>%
    rename(block_num = time_block)
  
  triplet_summary <- df_triplet_cgm %>%
    group_by(block_num) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cgm = mean(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cgm = sd(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  y_min <- floor(min(triplet_summary$mean_cgm - triplet_summary$sd_cgm, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 - 5
  y_max <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary$mean_cgm + triplet_summary$sd_cgm, 
                       na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 + 5
  
  third_letter <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  intervention_label <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "dim\n(10 lx)", "bright\n(1000 lx)")
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_type, 1, 2)
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  
  p <- ggplot(triplet_summary, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_cgm)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = intervention_label, 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
             color = ifelse(third_letter == "D", "grey50", "#B8860B"), 
             fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_cgm - sd_cgm,
                    ymax = mean_cgm + sd_cgm),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = c(
        "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
        "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
      ),
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote("Glucose levels time course - Triplet " * 
                     .(triplet_first_two) * bold(.(triplet_third))),
      subtitle = paste0("Grand average third-day (n=", 
                       length(unique(df_triplet_cgm$participant)), 
                       " participants; P07 excluded)"),
      x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Mean Glucose (mg/dL)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 5)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

# Summary Statistics for Triplet Time Course Analysis

```{r}
# Combine all triplet data for the unified table
triplets_all_list <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_cgm_unified <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_list) {
  df_triplet_cgm <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        p_data <- cgm %>%
          filter(participant == p, session_num == s) %>%
          filter(!is.na(timestamp), !is.na(glucose)) %>%
          mutate(timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%
          arrange(timestamp) %>%
          mutate(
            minutes_elapsed = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, min(timestamp), units = "mins")),
            time_block = floor(minutes_elapsed / 30) + 1
          ) %>%
          filter(time_block >= 1, time_block <= 10) %>%
          group_by(time_block) %>%
          summarise(
            cgm_30min = mean(glucose, na.rm = TRUE),
            participant = first(p),
            session_num = first(s),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          mutate(triplet = triplet_type)
        
        df_triplet_cgm <- rbind(df_triplet_cgm, p_data)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Assign block numbers
  df_triplet_cgm <- df_triplet_cgm %>%
    rename(block_num = time_block)
  
  df_all_triplets_cgm_unified <- rbind(df_all_triplets_cgm_unified, df_triplet_cgm)
}

# Calculate summary statistics per triplet and block
triplet_summary_cgm_unified <- df_all_triplets_cgm_unified %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cgm = mean(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cgm = sd(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_list))

# Create table with mean ± SD for all triplets
triplet_timecourse_cgm_table <- triplet_summary_cgm_unified %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sd = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean_cgm, sd_cgm)
  ) %>%
  select(triplet, block_num, mean_sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = block_num,
    values_from = mean_sd,
    names_prefix = "B"
  )

knitr::kable(
  triplet_timecourse_cgm_table,
  caption = "Triplet time-course: Mean ± SD glucose (mg/dL) per 30-minute block",
  align = c("l", rep("r", 10))
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                           full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# Grand Average Time Course

```{r}
# Map light conditions to each session for CGM
light_patterns <- list(
  P01 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P02 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P03 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P04 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P05 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P06 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P07 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P09 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")
)

# Add P10 pattern (12 sessions without session 5)
light_patterns[["P10"]] <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D")

df_light_cgm <- bind_rows(
  # All participants except P10
  bind_rows(lapply(names(light_patterns), function(p) {
    pattern <- light_patterns[[p]]
    data.frame(
      participant = p,
      exp_session = seq_along(pattern),
      light = pattern,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })),
  # P10 
  data.frame(
    participant = "P10",
    exp_session = 1:13,
    light = ifelse(1:13 %in% c(1,2,3,6,10,12,13), "D", "B"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

# Create CGM data with time blocks and light conditions
df_cgm_light <- cgm %>%
  filter(participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timestamp), !is.na(glucose)) %>%
  mutate(timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp)) %>%
  group_by(participant, session_num) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    minutes_elapsed = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, min(timestamp), units = "mins")),
    time_block = floor(minutes_elapsed / 30) + 1
  ) %>%
  filter(time_block >= 1, time_block <= 10) %>%
  group_by(participant, session_num, time_block) %>%
  summarise(cgm_30min = mean(glucose, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(exp_session = session_num) %>%
  inner_join(df_light_cgm, by = c("participant", "exp_session"))

# Assign block numbers (1-10)
df_cgm_light <- df_cgm_light %>%
  rename(block_num = time_block)

# Calculate per-participant summary
df_summary_cgm_per_participant <- df_cgm_light %>%
  group_by(participant, block_num, light) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cgm = mean(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cgm = sd(cgm_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_cgm = sd_cgm / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = c("D", "B"), labels = c("Dim", "Bright")))

# Grand average excluding P07
df_summary_cgm_noP07 <- df_summary_cgm_per_participant %>%
  filter(participant != "P07")

grand_summary_cgm_manual <- data.frame()

for(b in unique(df_summary_cgm_noP07$block_num)) {
  for(l in levels(df_summary_cgm_noP07$light)) {
    vals <- df_summary_cgm_noP07 %>%
      filter(block_num == b, light == l) %>%
      pull(mean_cgm)
    
    n_val <- length(vals)
    mean_val <- mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd_val / sqrt(n_val)
    
    grand_summary_cgm_manual <- rbind(grand_summary_cgm_manual, data.frame(
      block_num = b,
      light = l,
      mean_cgm = mean_val,
      sd_cgm = sd_val,
      n = n_val,
      se_cgm = se_val
    ))
  }
}

grand_summary_cgm_manual$light <- factor(grand_summary_cgm_manual$light, 
                                         levels = c("Bright", "Dim"))
```

```{r}
# Ensure block_num is numeric
grand_summary_cgm_manual <- grand_summary_cgm_manual %>%
  mutate(block_num = as.numeric(block_num))

# Define labels
hbt_values <- c("5.25", "4.75", "4.25", "3.75", "3.25", "2.75", "2.25", "1.75", "1.25", "0.75")

# Create x-axis labels
x_labels <- sapply(1:10, function(i) {
  if (i %% 2 == 1) {  
    paste0("B", i, "\n(", hbt_values[i], "h)")
  } else {  
    paste0("B", i)
  }
})

# Y-axis limits
y_min <- floor(min(grand_summary_cgm_manual$mean_cgm - grand_summary_cgm_manual$se_cgm, 
                   na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 - 5
y_max <- ceiling(max(grand_summary_cgm_manual$mean_cgm + grand_summary_cgm_manual$se_cgm, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5 + 5

# Create plot
ggplot(grand_summary_cgm_manual, 
       aes(x = block_num, y = mean_cgm, 
           color = light, fill = light, group = light)) +
  # Background shading
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.75, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.02, label = "dim\n(10 lx)",  
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.02, label = "intervention\n(10 or 1000 lx)",  
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "#B8860B", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.02, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") + 
  # Ribbon for SE
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_cgm - se_cgm,
                  ymax = mean_cgm + se_cgm),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Line and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16) +
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  # Axes 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = x_labels,
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Glucose levels time course",
    subtitle = "Grand average across participants (P07 excluded, n=8)",
    x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
    y = "Mean Glucose (mg/dL)",
    color = "Light condition",
    fill = "Light condition"
  ) +
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 5)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```
